definition: 20,000 training and 20,000 held-out conversations of a tool-using agent, on 283 training scans named in the text. Each is a list of turns ("from": function_call, gpt, human, observation; "value": text) with the system prompt and tool definitions. They were built by running each subtype's ground-truth tool trace against the tool cache (paper, Appendix e.4). The "images" field is empty in every conversation, although the paper describes a 2D image in the first turn.

evidence.locator: All 40,000 trajectories and the three tool caches; paper sections 3.3 and Appendix e.4

definition: Pre-computed tool outputs per scan: for each BDMAP ID, "segment" (per structure: mask found, voxel count, bounding box) and "measure" values. benchmark_oracle_tool_cache.json covers 991 benchmark scans from the ground-truth masks; benchmark_totalsegmentator_cache.json the same 991 from TotalSegmentator; training_oracle_tool_cache.json 283 training scans. The two latter files also hold a "knowledge" section with 16 entries.
